metadata.title: Digital Eye
metadata.description: A game to look, ask and check what you find online.

home.title: Train your digital eye
home.description: Learn to look, ask and check what you find online.
home.learningDescription: Before you believe or share, take a moment to investigate.

tutorial.introDescription: Look at both images and tap the one you think was made with AI.
tutorial.question: Which one was made with AI?
tutorial.tryAgain: Good try! Let’s check the clue.
tutorial.modelAria: Thinking steps: Look, Ask and Check
tutorial.completionDescription: You learned to look, ask and check.

round1.observation: Look: some letters do not form words. That detail can be a clue, but it is not proof on its own.
round1.explanation: Visual clues help us observe more carefully. Before we believe or share, we can ask more questions too.

round2.observation: Look: this scene has many details that seem possible.
round2.question: Ask: who made or published this image, and why?
round2.explanation: Looks alone do not tell the whole story. The source and purpose matter too.

round3.observation: Look: sometimes two images can seem equally possible.
round3.question: Ask: who shared it, and what information is missing?
round3.verification: Check: find the source and compare it with trusted information.
round3.uncertainty: We cannot always know just by looking. Check the source and context.
round3.explanation: It is normal to be unsure. Checking before believing or sharing is a responsible action.
